title: Remote Live Multiplayer & Presence
objective: Deliver reliable remote Campaign play around the existing Campaign/Session/Action/Event authority model.

scope.purpose: Deliver reliable remote Campaign play around the existing Campaign/Session/Action/Event authority model.
scope.completion_gate: Geographically separated ordinary users can join, play, disconnect/recover and continue without developer intervention or duplicate authoritative effects.

selection_boundaries: SMB-01 is completed_verified before SMB-02 implementation.
SMB-02 is the only authorized product-development work item for this attempt.
Campaign/Session/Action/Event authority remains canonical; remote transport and presence may not create parallel authoritative effects.

The SMB-01 production platform selection may be consumed behind its adapter boundaries, but paid/live provider activation, production deployment and public/tester distribution remain separately gated.
Implementation must establish a failing acceptance seam before production code and must pass exact-head Linux/Windows deterministic validation plus relevant MIB/SMB regressions.
SMB-03 and later work remain unauthorized until SMB-02 is completed_verified and canonical state advances.
next_action: Establish the SMB-02 RED acceptance profile against current application main, then implement the minimum authority-safe remote multiplayer/presence realization that satisfies join/play/disconnect/recover/continue without duplicate authoritative effects.
